scientific_integrity: Known 2002 fourteen-site compound and covering radius explicitly credited. Same-model scientific reconstruction only; numerical tests corroborate but do not establish infinite asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Fixed fourteen unit sites and uniform S² directions only; intermediate full CDF represented by finite one-dimensional quadrature; global covering optimality, other site sets, historical exhaustive priority and external validation are unproved.
title: Exact fourteen-site spherical coverage law and quadratic closure of the cube–octahedron gaps
